v11 counts every record from **one OBIS snapshot**: the monthly H3 store that
[marinebon/obisindicators](https://github.com/marinebon/obisindicators) refreshes on the Mac mini and
publishes beside its indicator layers as `obis-h3/vYYYYMMDD/`. The MST-facing export in that folder is

- `obis_cell.parquet` — `aphiaid, cell_id, date_year, records`: every OBIS species-level record count per
  MST `global05` cell (the cell holding the centroid of its H3 res-7 hexagon, ~5 km² against the cell's
  ~25 km²), `date_year` NULL where the record has no year;
- `worms_taxon.parquet` — the WoRMS taxonomy of the same release (read by `ingest_worms.qmd` under
  `WORMS_SOURCE=obisindicators`);
- `release.json` — whose `mst` block records `obis_snapshot` and `worms_version`.

The release is `OBIS_H3_RELEASE` (default `v20261012`), read from `{obis_h3_dir}/{release}` (`~/_big/obis/obis-h3`
on the laptop and the Mac mini) and, when that folder is absent, over HTTPS from `obis_h3_url`.

This notebook writes two things:

1. **`obs_obis`** — the occurrence-count table, kept whole (all 170,174 AphiaIDs, ~99 MB) as Parquet at
   `marine-atlas/obs/dataset=obs_obis/obis_cell.parquet` beside a copy of `worms_taxon.parquet` and the
   release's provenance. It is not in `dist/`, which is for `(mdl_key, cell_id, val)` model surfaces. Every
   v11 count (the occurrence rule, the R2 fallbacks, effort proxies) reads this one file.
2. **`rng_occ`** — for a configured species list (`data/v11/occ_species.csv`: the six sea turtles and the
   North Atlantic right whale; `OCC_SPECIES=137205,159023` selects a subset) the **cells within `d` km of any
   cell with ≥ 1 record**, as `dist/dataset=rng_occ/{aphiaid}_d{d}km.parquet` — `(mdl_key, cell_id, val)`,
   `mdl_key = "rng_occ|{aphiaid}"`, `val` = the species' extinction-risk score. One `d` per run
   (`OCC_BUFFER_KM`, default 100, `libs/vars.R`), recorded in the file name, in `model_rng_occ.csv` and in the
   manifest; a run at another `d`, another release or another species set clears the files it supersedes
   (the merge input globs `dist/*/*.parquet`, so a stale `d` must never survive beside a new one).

The **gate** at the end is the Q1 acceptance: for the six turtles and the right whale, the OBIS records per BOEM
ecoregion counted from `obis_cell.parquet` × the ecoregion zone cells must reproduce the v7c evidence table
(`data/v7c/records_species_ecoregion.csv`, channel `obis_all`, taken from the 2025-03-18 OBIS export) within the
snapshot difference.

## Design

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-design
%%| fig-cap: "obisindicators export → obs_obis table + rng_occ buffered-record range; gate against the v7c evidence counts"
flowchart LR
  rel["obis-h3/vYYYYMMDD/<br/>obis_cell + worms_taxon + release.json"] --> obs[("marine-atlas/obs/<br/>dataset=obs_obis/")]
  rel --> sp["species list<br/>data/v11/occ_species.csv"]
  sp --> rc["cells with >= 1 record"]
  rc --> buf["cells within d km<br/>(haversine on cell centres)"]
  buf --> rng[("dist/dataset=rng_occ/<br/>(mdl_key, cell_id, val)")]
  obs --> gate{"gate: records per ecoregion<br/>vs v7c obis_all"}
  zc["zones/ecoregion_2025-06/<br/>global05/zone_cell"] --> gate
  gate --> mf["hash → manifest"]
  rng --> mf
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(
  arrow, DBI, digest, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, logger, purrr, readr, stringr,
  tibble, MarineSensitivity/msens, quiet = T)
source(here("libs/paths.R"))          # ver, dir_big_v, dir_derived, obis_h3_*
source(here("libs/vars.R"))           # redo_ingest, occ_buffer_km
source(here("libs/obis_h3.R"))        # obis_h3_src(), obis_h3_info()
stopifnot("msens 0.62.1 or newer is required (cells_within_sql / cell_id_of)" = packageVersion("msens") >= "0.62.1")
source(here("libs/duckdb_budget.R"))  # duckdb_tune()
options(readr.show_col_types = F)

ds_key    <- "rng_occ"
dir_atlas <- path.expand(glue("{dir_big_v}/marine-atlas"))
dir_dist  <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/dataset={ds_key}")
dir_obs   <- glue("{dir_atlas}/obs/dataset=obs_obis")
f_model   <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/model_{ds_key}.csv")
manifest  <- here("data/manifests/ingest_obis_occurrence.json")
dir_create(c(dir_dist, dir_obs, path_dir(manifest)))
stopifnot("OCC_BUFFER_KM must be a positive number" = is.finite(occ_buffer_km) && occ_buffer_km > 0,
          "run build_cell_grid.qmd first" = file_exists(cellid_tif))
d_tag <- format(occ_buffer_km, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)   # 100 -> "100": the file-name tag

info <- obis_h3_info()
log_info("OBIS release {info$release}: OBIS {info$obis_snapshot}, WoRMS {info$worms_version}, ",
         "{format(info$n_rows, big.mark = ',')} rows / {format(info$records, big.mark = ',')} records ",
         "({if (info$remote) 'over HTTPS' else 'local folder'}); buffer d = {d_tag} km")

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
duckdb_tune(con, path.expand(glue("{dir_big_v}/_tmp")))
dbExecute(con, "SET preserve_insertion_order = true")   # the sorted COPYs below need it (duckdb_tune turns it off)
if (info$remote) obis_h3_httpfs(con)
```

## `obs_obis` — the occurrence counts, all AphiaIDs

The file is copied (re-encoded V2/zstd, sorted by `aphiaid, cell_id` so a per-species read prunes row groups),
not filtered: the pipeline's taxon table does not exist yet at this stage of a version, and the whole table is
99 MB. The copy is skipped when the folder already holds this release.

```{r}
#| label: obs

f_cell  <- glue("{dir_obs}/obis_cell.parquet")
f_worms <- glue("{dir_obs}/worms_taxon.parquet")
f_rel   <- glue("{dir_obs}/release.json")
prev    <- if (file_exists(f_rel)) read_json(f_rel) else list()
fresh   <- !redo_ingest && file_exists(f_cell) && file_exists(f_worms) &&
  identical(prev$release, info$release) && identical(prev$obis_snapshot, info$obis_snapshot)

if (fresh) {
  log_info("obs_obis already holds {info$release}; skipping the copy (REDO_INGEST=1 to force)")
} else {
  msens::copy_atlas_parquet(con, glue(
    "SELECT aphiaid, cell_id, date_year, records FROM read_parquet('{obis_h3_src('obis_cell.parquet')$path}')"),
    f_cell, order_by = "aphiaid, cell_id, date_year")
  msens::copy_atlas_parquet(con, glue(
    "SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{obis_h3_src('worms_taxon.parquet')$path}')"),
    f_worms, order_by = "taxonID")
  write_json(info[c("release", "obis_snapshot", "worms_version", "h3_res", "grid_id", "n_rows", "records", "n_aphiaid")],
             f_rel, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
}

obs <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, sum(records)::BIGINT AS records, count(DISTINCT aphiaid) AS n_aphiaid,
         min(cell_id) AS cell_min, max(cell_id) AS cell_max, count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_year IS NULL) AS n_no_year
  FROM read_parquet('{f_cell}')"))
n_worms <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("SELECT count(*) n FROM read_parquet('{f_worms}')"))$n
# the copy must be the release, row for row and record for record
stopifnot("obs_obis rows != release.json" = obs$n_rows == info$n_rows,
          "obs_obis records != release.json" = obs$records == info$records,
          "obs_obis AphiaIDs != release.json" = obs$n_aphiaid == info$n_aphiaid,
          "worms_taxon rows != release.json" = n_worms == info$files$worms_taxon$rows,
          "cell_id outside the global05 grid" = obs$cell_min >= 1, obs$cell_max <= 7200L * 3600L)
msens::report_table(
  tibble(release = info$release, obis_snapshot = info$obis_snapshot, worms_version = info$worms_version,
         rows = obs$n_rows, records = obs$records, aphiaids = obs$n_aphiaid, no_year_rows = obs$n_no_year,
         worms_taxa = n_worms),
  caption = "obs_obis: the copied OBIS occurrence counts")
```

## The species and their AphiaIDs

Each configured AphiaID is checked against the release's own WoRMS table (name, rank, status): a wrong id would
buffer another species' records without any error. Records filed under a synonym's AphiaID count toward the
accepted species (none do in v20261012 — OBIS files them under the accepted id — but the join is by
`acceptedNameUsageID`, so a later release that did would not drop them).

```{r}
#| label: species

sp <- read_csv(here("data/v11/occ_species.csv"))
sel <- Sys.getenv("OCC_SPECIES")
if (nzchar(sel)) {
  ids <- as.integer(strsplit(sel, ",")[[1]])
  stopifnot("OCC_SPECIES names an AphiaID not in data/v11/occ_species.csv" = all(ids %in% sp$aphiaid))
  sp <- filter(sp, aphiaid %in% ids)
}
stopifnot(nrow(sp) > 0, !anyDuplicated(sp$aphiaid))

w <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT taxonID AS aphiaid, scientificName, taxonRank, taxonomicStatus
  FROM read_parquet('{f_worms}') WHERE taxonID IN ({paste(sp$aphiaid, collapse = ',')})"))
chk <- sp |> left_join(w, by = "aphiaid")
stopifnot("an AphiaID is not in worms_taxon.parquet" = !anyNA(chk$scientificName),
          "an AphiaID's WoRMS name differs from data/v11/occ_species.csv" = all(chk$scientificName == chk$scientific_name),
          "an AphiaID is not an accepted species" = all(chk$taxonRank == "Species" & chk$taxonomicStatus == "accepted"))

sp <- sp |>
  mutate(mdl_key  = mdl_key_raw(ds_key, aphiaid),
         er_score = map_dbl(er_code, compute_er_score),   # the range value: NEVER hard-coded
         file     = as.character(glue("{dir_dist}/{aphiaid}_d{d_tag}km.parquet")))
msens::report_table(select(chk, aphiaid, scientific_name, common_name, taxonRank, taxonomicStatus),
                    caption = "Species checked against worms_taxon.parquet")
```

## Cells with at least one record

```{r}
#| label: record-cells

dbExecute(con, glue("
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE sp_ids AS
  SELECT w.taxonID AS aphiaid, coalesce(w.acceptedNameUsageID, w.taxonID) AS sp_aphia
  FROM read_parquet('{f_worms}') w
  WHERE coalesce(w.acceptedNameUsageID, w.taxonID) IN ({paste(sp$aphiaid, collapse = ',')})"))
dbExecute(con, glue("
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE rc AS
  SELECT s.sp_aphia AS aphiaid, o.cell_id, sum(o.records)::BIGINT AS n
  FROM read_parquet('{f_cell}') o JOIN sp_ids s ON o.aphiaid = s.aphiaid
  WHERE o.records >= 1
  GROUP BY 1, 2"))   # basis of record is not in the export: every record counts, as in the v7c obis_all channel
rc_n <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT aphiaid, count(*) AS n_record_cells, sum(n) AS n_records FROM rc GROUP BY 1")
sp <- sp |> left_join(rc_n, by = "aphiaid")
stopifnot("a configured species has no OBIS record at all" = !anyNA(sp$n_record_cells))
```

## `rng_occ` — the cells within d km of a record

A cell is within `d` km when the great-circle distance between its **centre** and the centre of a record cell is
≤ `d` (`msens::cells_within_sql()`, unit-tested against a brute-force scan: haversine, R = 6371.0088 km, in DuckDB on the `cell_id`
arithmetic — no spatial extension, no raster). The column index wraps modulo 7200, so the **antimeridian
needs no special case** (the Aleutians and Fiji are one contiguous neighbourhood), and the longitude reach of
the cap widens with latitude (`asin(sin(d/R)/cos(lat))`, every longitude when the cap holds a pole). The
whole grid is buffered, land cells included: this is a range dataset, and "how marine" is derived at the merge.
The self-test below checks the SQL against a brute-force scan of all 25.9 M cells.

```{r}
#| label: buffer

# clear what this run supersedes: another release, another d, or a species no longer configured
prev_model <- if (file_exists(f_model)) read_csv(f_model) else NULL
same_run <- !redo_ingest && !is.null(prev_model) && "release" %in% names(prev_model) &&
  all(prev_model$release == info$release) && all(prev_model$obis_snapshot == info$obis_snapshot) &&
  all(prev_model$buffer_km == occ_buffer_km)
have <- as.character(dir_ls(dir_dist, glob = "*.parquet"))
drop <- if (same_run) setdiff(have, sp$file) else have
if (length(drop)) {
  log_info("clearing {length(drop)} rng_occ file(s) from another release / d / species set")
  file_delete(drop)
}
# the crosswalk first (counts are filled at the end), so a killed run resumes only its own release + d
sp_model <- function(sp) {
  if (!"n_cells" %in% names(sp)) sp$n_cells <- NA_integer_
  transmute(sp, mdl_key, sp_id = aphiaid, worms_id = aphiaid, scientific_name, common_name, er_code, er_score,
            buffer_km = occ_buffer_km, n_record_cells, n_records, n_cells,
            release = info$release, obis_snapshot = info$obis_snapshot)
}
write_csv(sp_model(sp), f_model)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sp))) {
  s <- sp[i, ]
  if (file_exists(s$file)) { log_info("{s$aphiaid} {s$common_name}: skip (exists)"); next }
  dbExecute(con, glue("CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE src AS SELECT cell_id FROM rc WHERE aphiaid = {s$aphiaid}"))
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  msens::copy_atlas_parquet(con, glue(
    "SELECT '{s$mdl_key}' AS mdl_key, cell_id, {s$er_score}::DOUBLE AS val FROM ({msens::cells_within_sql('src', occ_buffer_km)})"),
    s$file, order_by = "cell_id")
  log_info("{s$aphiaid} {s$common_name}: {s$n_record_cells} record cells -> buffered in ",
           "{round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'secs')), 1)} s")
}
```

## Verify

```{r}
#| label: verify

# (1) the SQL buffer equals a brute-force scan, at the antimeridian (both sides), mid-latitude, the equator and both poles
tests <- tribble(
  ~name,             ~lon,     ~lat,
  "antimeridian E",   179.975,    0.025,
  "antimeridian W",  -179.975,   60.025,
  "equator",           10.025,    0.025,
  "Bering 70N",      -179.975,   70.025,
  "north pole cap",     0.025,   89.975,
  "south pole cap",  -120.025,  -89.975,
  "Oregon coast",    -124.775,   48.625)
# brute force over ALL 25.9 M cells (test-only; the rule itself is msens::cells_within_sql)
occ_buffer_brute_sql <- function(cell_id, d_km, ncol = 7200L, nrow = 3600L, deg = 0.05) {
  R_km <- 6371.0088
  glue::glue("
    WITH a AS (
      SELECT 90 - (({cell_id} - 1) // {ncol} + 0.5) * {deg} AS lat0,
             -180 + (({cell_id} - 1) % {ncol} + 0.5) * {deg} AS lon0),
    g AS (
      SELECT (i + 1)::INTEGER AS cell_id, 90 - (i // {ncol} + 0.5) * {deg} AS lat1, -180 + (i % {ncol} + 0.5) * {deg} AS lon1
      FROM range(0, {ncol * nrow}) t(i))
    SELECT g.cell_id FROM g, a
    WHERE 2 * {R_km} * asin(sqrt(least(1,
            pow(sin(radians(lat1 - lat0) / 2), 2) +
            cos(radians(lat0)) * cos(radians(lat1)) * pow(sin(radians(lon1 - lon0) / 2), 2)))) <= {d_km}
    ORDER BY g.cell_id", .trim = TRUE)
}
selftest <- pmap_dfr(tests, \(name, lon, lat) {
  cid <- msens::cell_id_of(lon, lat)
  dbWriteTable(con, "t1", tibble(cell_id = cid), overwrite = TRUE)
  a <- dbGetQuery(con, paste(msens::cells_within_sql("t1", occ_buffer_km), "ORDER BY 1"))$cell_id
  b <- dbGetQuery(con, occ_buffer_brute_sql(cid, occ_buffer_km))$cell_id
  tibble(name, cell_id = cid, n_sql = length(a), n_brute = length(b), identical = identical(a, b)) })
stopifnot("msens::cells_within_sql() differs from the brute-force haversine scan" = all(selftest$identical))
msens::report_table(selftest, caption = glue("Self-test: msens::cells_within_sql() vs brute force over every cell, d = {d_tag} km"))

# (2) the written surfaces
sm <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT mdl_key, count(*) AS n_cells, min(cell_id) AS cell_min, max(cell_id) AS cell_max,
         min(val) AS val_min, max(val) AS val_max, count(DISTINCT cell_id) AS n_distinct
  FROM read_parquet('{dir_dist}/*.parquet', hive_partitioning = false) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"))
chk <- sp |> select(mdl_key, er_score, n_record_cells) |> inner_join(sm, by = "mdl_key")
stopifnot("a species has no rng_occ surface" = nrow(chk) == nrow(sp),
          "rng_occ rows are not distinct cells" = all(chk$n_cells == chk$n_distinct),
          "cell_id outside [1, 25,920,000]" = all(chk$cell_min >= 1, chk$cell_max <= 7200L * 3600L),
          "val != the species' compute_er_score()" = all(chk$val_min == chk$er_score & chk$val_max == chk$er_score),
          "the buffer lost record cells" = all(chk$n_cells >= chk$n_record_cells))
# (3) every record cell is inside its own buffer
miss <- sum(map_dbl(seq_len(nrow(sp)), \(i) dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT count(*) n FROM rc WHERE aphiaid = {sp$aphiaid[i]}
    AND cell_id NOT IN (SELECT cell_id FROM read_parquet('{sp$file[i]}'))"))$n))
stopifnot("a record cell is missing from its own buffer" = miss == 0)

sp <- sp |> left_join(select(sm, mdl_key, n_cells), by = "mdl_key")
write_csv(sp_model(sp), f_model)
msens::report_table(
  sp |> transmute(aphiaid, species = common_name, er_score, record_cells = n_record_cells, records = n_records,
                  buffer_km = occ_buffer_km, rng_occ_cells = n_cells),
  caption = "rng_occ: cells within d km of a record, per species")
```

## Gate — records per ecoregion against the v7c evidence

For the six turtles and the right whale: the OBIS records per BOEM ecoregion counted here (`obis_cell.parquet`
× the shared ecoregion zone cells of the `global05` grid) against `data/v7c/records_species_ecoregion.csv`,
channel `obis_all` (the OBIS export of 2025-03-18, `build_v7c_exclusions.qmd`).

**Assignment follows the v7c count so the two are comparable:** a cell goes to the ecoregion covering most of it
(`pct_covered`, ties to the first key — `msens::cell_zone_major_sql()`'s rule), and a cell in no ecoregion (a
beach or harbour record) goes to the nearest ecoregion cell within 5 cells (0.25°, ≈ 25 km), searched on the
grid. Records without a year count.

**Resolution caveat.** v7c located each record by its coordinates, to its 0.05° cell; here the record is the
centroid cell of its H3 res-7 hexagon (≤ ~2.5 km from the point), so a record within a hex of an ecoregion edge
or of the 25-km search radius can fall on the other side. And v7c intersected cells with the v7 ecoregion
vintage on the `usa05` grid; the zone cells here are the `global05` extract of the same polygons. Counts near an
edge therefore move by a few records either way.

**Rules** (per species × ecoregion; `old` = the v7c count, `new` = this snapshot):

- *zero*: `old = 0` ⇒ `new = 0` — a place v7c found never recorded must still be so, else the v7c exclusions
  (turtles out of the East Bering Sea, the right whale out of the Gulf of America) lose their evidence;
- *lower*: `new ≥ old − max(5, 2 % of old)` — OBIS only grows between snapshots; the slack is the edge effect above;
- *upper*: `new ≤ 1.5 × old + 5` — the growth the snapshot difference can account for.

A deviation passes only when `data/v11/obis_gate_reviewed.csv` lists the pair and rule with `status = accepted`
and a reason; anything else stops the render (`OBIS_GATE=warn` logs it instead, for a look at the table).

```{r}
#| label: gate

gate_mode <- match.arg(Sys.getenv("OBIS_GATE", "stop"), c("stop", "warn"))
f_zc  <- path.expand(glue("{dir_derived}/zones/ecoregion_2025-06/global05/zone_cell.parquet"))
f_v7c <- here("data/v7c/records_species_ecoregion.csv")
stopifnot("ecoregion zone_cell (global05) missing: build_zone_sets.qmd" = file_exists(f_zc), file_exists(f_v7c))

old <- read_csv(f_v7c) |> filter(channel == "obis_all") |>
  transmute(common, aphia = as.integer(aphia), eco, old = as.integer(n))
g_ids <- unique(old$aphia)

dbExecute(con, glue("
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE cz AS
  SELECT cell_id, zone_key FROM (
    SELECT cell_id, zone_key, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cell_id ORDER BY pct_covered DESC, zone_key) AS r
    FROM read_parquet('{f_zc}')) WHERE r = 1"))
dbExecute(con, glue("
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE g_ids AS
  SELECT w.taxonID AS aphiaid, coalesce(w.acceptedNameUsageID, w.taxonID) AS sp_aphia
  FROM read_parquet('{f_worms}') w WHERE coalesce(w.acceptedNameUsageID, w.taxonID) IN ({paste(g_ids, collapse = ',')})"))
dbExecute(con, glue("
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE g_oc AS
  SELECT g.sp_aphia AS aphia, o.cell_id, sum(o.records)::BIGINT AS n
  FROM read_parquet('{f_cell}') o JOIN g_ids g ON o.aphiaid = g.aphiaid WHERE o.records >= 1 GROUP BY 1, 2"))
# cells in no ecoregion -> the nearest ecoregion cell within 5 cells (distance in cells, circular offsets), column wrap at 7200
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE g_un AS SELECT DISTINCT cell_id FROM g_oc WHERE cell_id NOT IN (SELECT cell_id FROM cz)")
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE g_off AS
  SELECT dr, dc, dr * dr + dc * dc AS d2 FROM range(-5, 6) a(dr), range(-5, 6) b(dc) WHERE dr * dr + dc * dc <= 25")
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE g_near AS
  SELECT cell_id, zone_key AS eco_near FROM (
    SELECT u.cell_id, cz.zone_key,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY u.cell_id ORDER BY o.d2, cz.zone_key) AS r
    FROM g_un u CROSS JOIN g_off o
    JOIN cz ON cz.cell_id = (((u.cell_id - 1) // 7200 + o.dr) * 7200 + ((u.cell_id - 1) % 7200 + o.dc + 7200) % 7200 + 1)
    WHERE (u.cell_id - 1) // 7200 + o.dr BETWEEN 0 AND 3599) WHERE r = 1")
new <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT o.aphia, coalesce(cz.zone_key, n.eco_near) AS eco,
         sum(o.n)::BIGINT AS new, (sum(o.n) FILTER (WHERE cz.zone_key IS NOT NULL))::BIGINT AS new_in_cells
  FROM g_oc o LEFT JOIN cz USING (cell_id) LEFT JOIN g_near n USING (cell_id)
  WHERE coalesce(cz.zone_key, n.eco_near) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2") |> as_tibble() |>
  mutate(aphia = as.integer(aphia))

cmp <- old |>
  left_join(new, by = c("aphia", "eco")) |>
  mutate(across(c(new, new_in_cells), \(x) coalesce(as.integer(x), 0L)),
         lower_ok = new >= old - pmax(5, 0.02 * old),
         upper_ok = new <= 1.5 * old + 5,
         rule     = case_when(old == 0L & new > 0L ~ "zero",
                              !lower_ok            ~ "lower",
                              !upper_ok            ~ "upper",
                              TRUE                 ~ NA_character_),
         verdict  = if_else(is.na(rule), "ok", paste("DEVIATES:", rule)),
         ratio    = round(if_else(old > 0L, new / old, NA_real_), 2)) |>
  arrange(factor(aphia, g_ids), eco)
msens::report_table(
  cmp |> select(species = common, aphia, eco, `v7c obis_all (2025-03-18)` = old, `this snapshot` = new,
                `of which in-ecoregion cells` = new_in_cells, ratio, verdict),
  caption = glue("OBIS records per ecoregion: v7c evidence vs {info$obis_snapshot} snapshot ",
                 "({nrow(cmp)} species x ecoregion pairs)"))

f_rev <- here("data/v11/obis_gate_reviewed.csv")
reviewed <- if (file_exists(f_rev)) read_csv(f_rev) else tibble(aphia = integer(), eco = character(), rule = character(), status = character(), reason = character())
dev   <- cmp |> filter(!is.na(rule)) |>
  left_join(mutate(reviewed, aphia = as.integer(aphia)), by = c("aphia", "eco", "rule"))
unreviewed <- dev |> filter(is.na(status) | status != "accepted")
n_zero_kept <- cmp |> filter(old == 0L, new == 0L) |> nrow()
log_info("gate: {nrow(cmp)} pairs; {sum(cmp$old == 0L)} zero in v7c ({n_zero_kept} still zero); ",
         "{nrow(dev)} deviate ({nrow(unreviewed)} not accepted in obis_gate_reviewed.csv)")
if (nrow(unreviewed)) {
  print(msens::report_table(unreviewed |> select(common, aphia, eco, old, new, rule, status),
                            caption = "Gate deviations that no accepted row in data/v11/obis_gate_reviewed.csv covers"))
  msg <- glue("OBIS gate: {nrow(unreviewed)} species x ecoregion pair(s) deviate from the v7c evidence beyond the ",
              "snapshot tolerance and are not accepted in data/v11/obis_gate_reviewed.csv (OBIS_GATE=warn to log instead)")
  if (gate_mode == "stop") stop(msg) else log_warn(msg)
}
```

## Manifest

```{r}
#| label: manifest

h_rng <- msens::hash_parquet(glue("{dir_dist}/*.parquet"), con)
h_obs <- msens::hash_parquet(f_cell, con)
h     <- digest(c(h_rng, h_obs), algo = "xxhash64", serialize = TRUE)
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# content-addressed manifest: deterministic (no wall-clock, no machine paths), so downstream targets re-run only
# when the surfaces or the snapshot change. The snapshot and WoRMS version are recorded: every v11 record count
# comes from this one release.
msens::write_manifest(
  manifest, target = "ingest_obis_occurrence", content_hash = h,
  stats = list(
    ds_key = ds_key, ver = ver, release = info$release, obis_snapshot = info$obis_snapshot,
    worms_version = info$worms_version, h3_res = info$h3_res, buffer_km = occ_buffer_km,
    n_species = nrow(sp), n_rng_occ_cells = sum(sp$n_cells), hash_rng_occ = h_rng, hash_obs_obis = h_obs,
    obs_rows = obs$n_rows, obs_records = obs$records, obs_aphiaid = obs$n_aphiaid,
    gate_pairs = nrow(cmp), gate_zero_pairs = sum(cmp$old == 0L), gate_zero_kept = n_zero_kept,
    gate_deviations = nrow(dev), gate_unreviewed = nrow(unreviewed)),
  force = msens::force_target("ingest_obis_occurrence"))
```
